integrity: The delayed Jacobian is reconstructed directly from the printed nonlinear model, the phase reduction is algebraic, and all numerical thresholds are recomputed from exact formulas. Search-based originality assessment is non-exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns imaginary-axis crossings of the printed linearized fractional delay equation. It does not prove nonlinear Hopf direction, periodic-orbit stability, or global dynamics. The source-date metadata differs by one day between OpenAlex and the publisher; the earlier bibliographic date is retained.
title: Exact phase reduction and corrected first crossing in a fractional Lotka–Volterra feedback example
